verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework, so containing risky tool runs is an applicable axis. The evidence shows no container/VM sandboxing, tool policies, or permission modes that limit what tools the agent can touch. Input/output guardrails, workflow-level human-in-the-loop approval, and blocking external model providers are adjacent controls and do not constrain tool execution itself.

support.subject: As a security engineer, risky tool runs are containable — container/VM sandboxing, tool policies, or permission modes that limit what the agent can touch
